action.description: Which operation to perform — pass its matching params object below (action: "find" pairs with find: {...}).

titleContains.description: Match meetings whose title contains this string (case-insensitive).

participant.description: Match meetings with this person among the attendees — an email, an email domain ("acme.com"), or a name. Matches the organizer too.

url.description: Match by a meeting or recording link the user pasted — e.g. a Fathom call URL or a Circleback recording URL. Substring match against both meeting_url and recording_url, so the bare id from a pasted link works as well as the whole URL.

conversationId.description: Only meetings already attached to this deal.

dateFrom.description: ISO 8601 — meetings at or after this time.

dateTo.description: ISO 8601 — meetings at or before this time.

hasTranscript.description: When true, only meetings whose transcript actually made it into Cedar.

conversationId.description: The EXISTING Cedar deal to attach the meeting to. Defaults to the conversation currently in context — pass it explicitly when the user means a different deal.

externalId.description: The provider's own meeting id, if you already have it from a previous call.

titleContains.description: Narrow the provider window to meetings whose title contains this.

participant.description: Narrow to meetings with this attendee — email, email domain, or name.

url.description: Narrow by a pasted meeting/recording link (substring match).

organizer.description: Narrow to meetings this person organized/hosted (email or name).

recordedBy.description: Narrow to meetings recorded by these people. NOTE: who hit record, which is not the same as who attended — use `participant` for attendance.

teams.description: The provider's own team grouping, where it has one. NOT APPLIED by any recorder today — passing it makes this tool return candidates to confirm instead of attaching.

meetingType.description: The provider's own meeting-type taxonomy, where it has one. NOT APPLIED by any recorder today — passing it makes this tool return candidates to confirm instead of attaching. Prefer `titleContains` if the type is in the title.

daysBack.description: How far back to ask the provider for. This is the ONLY window most providers accept, so keep it as tight as the user's description allows.

providerId.description: Force a specific provider. Omit to use the user's connected one.
Ask about a specific recorder. Omit to describe the user's own connected one.

user_request_summary.description: One sentence, in your own words: what the user actually asked you to do in this turn. Used only for Cedar's observability — it does not change what this tool does.

is_new_request.description: true on the FIRST Cedar tool call of a NEW user request; false when this call continues the same request you are already working on. Groups related calls into one activity thread.
